title: Git
description: The version control system behind almost every modern codebase — how to actually understand what it's doing, not just memorize commands.

changelog.notes: Initial release — 39 decks, 291 cards, each pack with a preview card teaching the concept before its graded main card and practice cards.
Wrapped code, commands and file names in backticks so they render as code (92 card(s)).
Code mentioned inside question and answer text (commands, function calls, keywords such as for/None/True, file names, flags) is now marked as code, so it shows in the code font and colors.
